title: Maximum Subarray
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, find the contiguous non-empty subarray (containing at least one number) which has the largest sum, and return that maximum sum.

A subarray is a contiguous part of an array. Solve this in `O(n)` time and `O(1)` auxiliary space.
hints: As you scan left to right, decide at each index whether to extend the best subarray ending at the previous index or start a new subarray at the current element.
If the running sum before nums[i] is negative, carrying it forward only hurts the sum — reset to nums[i].
Track the global maximum across all ending positions (Kadane's algorithm), initializing both running and best sums to nums[0] so all-negative arrays are handled properly.

examples.explanation: The subarray [4, -1, 2, 1] has the largest sum 6.
The entire array [5, 4, -1, 7, 8] achieves the maximum sum 23.
